interface.shortDescription: Yespo's AI agent. Less clicking, more doing.
interface.longDescription: Meet the Yespo Agent: the teammate who never gets tired, never says "I'll circle back," and is suspiciously enthusiastic about doing the boring stuff for you. It helps your team work with Yespo or eSputnik in Codex or Cowork, answer questions, dig things up, and keep workflows moving without turning every task into a small corporate tragedy. Despite the Yespo name, it works identically for eSputnik accounts too — connect either the yespo or esputnik MCP server (or both) depending on which account you use. Think of it as an extra pair of hands, except faster, calmer, and much better at remembering where things are.
